title: Ezra Reads the Law

questions.question: Where did the people gather as one man?
options: The square before the Water Gate
questions.correctAnswer: The square before the Water Gate
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:1 (ESV): "...into the square before the Water Gate."

questions.question: Who brought the Book of the Law of Moses?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:1 (ESV): "...And they told Ezra the scribe to bring the Book of the Law of Moses..."

questions.question: Who could listen to the reading?
options: Men and women and all who could understand
questions.correctAnswer: Men and women and all who could understand
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:2 (ESV): "...both men and women and all who could understand what they heard..."

questions.question: How did the people respond when Ezra opened the book?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:5 (ESV): "...And as he opened it all the people stood."

questions.question: What did the people do when they heard the words of the Law?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:9 (ESV): "...For all the people wept when they heard the words of the Law."

questions.question: What platform did Ezra stand on?
options: A wooden platform made for the purpose
questions.correctAnswer: A wooden platform made for the purpose
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:4 (ESV): "And Ezra the scribe stood on a wooden platform that they had made for the purpose."

questions.question: Who helped the people to understand the Law?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:7 (ESV): "Also Jeshua, Bani... and the Levites, helped the people to understand the Law..."

questions.question: What did Nehemiah, Ezra, and the Levites tell the people not to do?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:9 (ESV): "...This day is holy to the LORD your God; do not mourn or weep."

questions.question: What were they to send to those for whom nothing was prepared?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:10 (ESV): "...and send portions to anyone for whom nothing is ready..."

questions.question: What feast did they find written in the Law to celebrate in the seventh month?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:14 (ESV): "...that the people of Israel should dwell in booths during the feast of the seventh month..."

questions.question: What materials did they use to make booths?
options: Branches of olive, wild olive, myrtle, palm, and other leafy trees
questions.correctAnswer: Branches of olive, wild olive, myrtle, palm, and other leafy trees
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:15 (ESV): "...Go out to the hills and bring branches of olive, wild olive, myrtle, palm, and other leafy trees to make booths..."

questions.question: Since whose days had the people not done so?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:17 (ESV): "...for from the days of Jeshua the son of Nun to that day the people of Israel had not done so."

questions.question: How long did the feast last?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:18 (ESV): "And day by day... he read from the Book of the Law... They kept the feast seven days..."

questions.question: What happened on the eighth day?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:18 (ESV): "...and on the eighth day there was a solemn assembly, according to the rule."

questions.question: Why is the joy of the LORD important according to Nehemiah?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 8:10 (ESV): "...for the joy of the LORD is your strength."

key_verse_text: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat and drink sweet wine and send portions to anyone for whom nothing is ready, for this day is holy to our Lord. And do not be grieved, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”
